data.data:
▼//[Test Information]

Test Start Time: Jan 16, 2025, 22:00 (UTC-5)

*The End Time will be announced later.

Test Type: Limited access, free of charge, no progress carryover

Platform: PC (Windows) only

Daily Reset: 04:00 (server time)


▼//[Server Time Zone]

Americas / Europe: UTC-5

Asia: UTC+8


This test uses a work-in-progress game build. The content of the test version, such as stats, stories, lore, art, visuals, etc., may differ significantly from the official version and does not represent the final quality of the game.


▼//[Notice of Test]

◆ The device where you log into the game for the first time will be registered as your test device for this test. Throughout the test, you are NOT allowed to switch to other devices. Please refrain from upgrading or reinstalling the operating system on your test device before the test ends, or you will not be able to log into the game. Attempting to log in on devices other than your test device will revoke your test access! And you will not be able to restore your test access during the test period.

◆ If suspicious activity is detected on your account or if you engage in unfair practices, violate event rules, laws, regulations, or exhibit other behaviors that undermine the fairness of the game, your test access will be revoked, and there will be no appeals process during this test.

◆ Only the test access owner can log into the test account. Please do not trust any information related to account sharing or trading, and refrain from activities such as transferring or gifting test access to avoid unnecessary losses.

◆ To ensure the complete gaming experience for testing players, please refrain from analyzing, modifying, or disseminating related analytical materials for the Beta Test installation package.


▼//[System Requirements]

The current version's performance, stability, and overall capabilities have not yet reached their optimal state. If you encounter performance issues, such as low frame rates or screen stuttering, you can go to the settings menu in the game to adjust the graphics quality and frame rate options that match your device configuration.

Controllers are not supported in this test for the time being, and we appreciate your understanding.


To ensure an optimal testing experience, we recommend using the following configuration:


▼//<SYSTEM> Windows 10 / 11 64-bit

————————————————————————————

<CPU>

Recommended Intel Core i7-10700K or equivalent, or better CPUs

Minimum Intel Core i5-9400F or equivalent, or better CPUs

————————————————————————————

<GPU>

Recommended NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or equivalent, or better GPUs

Minimum NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6G or equivalent, or better GPUs

————————————————————————————

<RAM>

Recommended 32GB

Minimum 16GB

————————————————————————————

<Storage> 60GB free space or higher, SSD Recommended


▼//[Feedback]

If you encounter any issues during the test, please provide your feedback through the following method:

- Click "Customer Support" on the login screen


Thank you for your continuous support for Arknights: Endfield, Endministrator! Enjoy your trip at Talos-II!
